description_en: Queries the monitoring data of an Elastic IP Address (EIP). You can query data generated within the last 31 days, and a single query returns up to 400 traffic data points
description_zh: 调用DescribeEipMonitorData接口查看弹性公网IP（Elastic IP Address，简称EIP）的监控信息，最多查询31天内的数据，单次最多查询400个流量点的数据
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-eip-monitor-data --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --allocation-id eip-2zeerraiwb7uj6idcfv0000 --start-time 2020-01-05T01:05:05Z --end-time 2020-01-05T03:05:10Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeEipMonitorData

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the EIP. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
EIP所属地域ID。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the EIP
parameters.name: allocation_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the data query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC. For example, 20:00:00 on January 10, 2013 (UTC+8) is specified as `2013-01-10T12:00:00Z`. If the specified time is not an exact minute, the next minute is automatically used as the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的起始时间。使用UTC时间。按照ISO8601标准，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`。例如，北京时间2013年01月10日20点00分00秒，表示为`2013-01-10T12:00:00Z`。

如果不是整分，则自动取下一分钟为起始时间点。
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the data query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC. For example, 20:00:00 on January 10, 2013 (UTC+8) is specified as `2013-01-10T12:00:00Z`. If the specified time is not an exact minute, the next minute is automatically used as the end time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间。使用UTC时间。按照ISO8601标准，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`。例如，北京时间2013年01月10日20点00分00秒，表示为`2013-01-10T12:00:00Z`。

如果不是整分，则自动取下一分钟为结束时间点。
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time interval of each monitoring data point. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 60 (default), 300, 900, and 3600.
If the value of (EndTime - StartTime) / Period is less than or equal to 400, all monitoring data between the start time and the end time is returned.
If the value of (EndTime - StartTime) / Period is greater than 400, monitoring data cannot be returned
parameters.help_zh:
每条监控数据的时间长度。单位：秒。取值：60（默认值） 、300 、 900 或 3600。
如果（EndTime–StartTime）/ Period小于等于400，可正常返回起始时间点到结束时间点的所有监控数据。
如果（EndTime–StartTime）/ Period大于400，无法正常返回监控数据
parameters.name: period
